verdict.rationale: Ghostty is configured through a plain-text configuration file. It exposes hundreds of options, including keybindings and one-line theme selection, and supports splitting config across multiple files via the `config-file` key, which suits a dotfiles layout. Changes can be reloaded at runtime, and community users share key = value config lines, confirming the text format in practice. Missing for 10: documented config file location/path conventions, guidance for per-OS conditional config when syncing between macOS and Linux (default bindings differ by platform), and independent hands-on reports of dotfiles-based sync across machines.
